ideas.title: A membership shelf for tools people rarely use
ideas.summary: Neighbours borrow drills and ladders from a shared lockup for a monthly fee, instead of buying tools they need once.

ideas.title: A weekly plant-care route for small offices
ideas.summary: One person waters the plants in a cluster of small offices each week. Each office pays a flat fee so nobody on staff has to remember.

ideas.title: After-hours pickup lockers for independent shops
ideas.summary: Lockers let customers collect paid orders after a shop has closed, so the shop can sell into the evening without staying open.
